messages:
maya_patel: Nightly eval alert — medical-faq prompt set hallucination rate jumped ~6x after yesterday's int8 bring-up for rwin-3b-v2q. Sample failures look like invented drug interactions. @liam can you repro?
liam_chen: Repro locally with the quant profile. Seed 42, temp 0.7. Getting confident-sounding but wrong claims, e.g. 'do not combine drugX with aspirin' when prompt never mentions drugX.
samir_khan: Oof. Is this specific to med-faq or showing across other prompt families?
liam_chen: Mostly med-faq and clinical-summaries subset. Minimal change on chit-chat and code tasks.
jere my_wu: (typo: jeremy_wu) Do we have a diff of kernel choices between int8 and int16 runs? Could be attention scaling or dequant noise.
liam_chen: Uploading quick logs: ```quant_profile: int8_dyn_range=true
kernel=fast_attn_v2
per_channel_scaling=true
sequence_len=512```
maya_patel: eval-bot posted the nightly CSV with counts — med-faq hallucinations 3.2% -> 19.8% after deploy. Attaching one example output inline: "Patient on metformin asks about combining with statin; model fabricates a contraindication with statin Y causing renal failure."
eval-bot: nightly-eval: dataset=medical-faq, model=rwin-3b-v2q-int8, halluc_rate=19.8%, baseline=rwin-3b-v2q-fp16:3.2%, alert=HIGH
jeremy_wu: That example is scary — model invents a dangerous interaction. Need immediate mitigation. Suggest rollback to fp16 variant for hosted and dedicated until we root-cause.
liam_chen: Quick repro script attached in thread gist: ```python
# repro snippet
out = client.generate(model='rwin-3b-v2q-int8', prompt=prompt, temperature=0.7, max_tokens=120, seed=42)
print(out.text)
```
samir_khan: Also try disabling per_channel_scaling in quant profile — I saw odd bias shifts before. Could be dequantizing in query/key matmul.
maya_patel: Ops: oncall-bot flagged that the int8 rollout happened at 01:12UTC yesterday and affected 3 clusters (staging+canary+prod-small). Can we throttle the rollout?
oncall-bot: rollout-monitor: model=rwin-3b-v2q-int8, staged=3 clusters, auto-rollback=false, manual rollback suggested. Reaction :warning:
liam_chen: I can spin a quick A/B: route 10% to fp16 variant, 90% to int8 for the med-faq tag and re-run nightly metrics. That should show signal.
jeremy_wu: Meanwhile create a temporary postprocess filter for medical prompts that checks for hallucination tokens/novel-entities and falls back to fp16 when confidence low. Not perfect but reduce user risk.
maya_patel: Agree. Action items: 1) liam pin 10% A/B and run fresh eval (ETA 30m); 2) samir try quant tweak (disable per_channel_scaling) and test; 3) jeremy prototype fallback filter; 4) ops hold further int8 rollouts. I'll open a ticket and assign to eng-ml.
liam_chen: Starting A/B now. Will post results.
samir_khan: Running quick quant_ablate tests now.
jeremy_wu: I'll draft a short alert message for SRE/Trust teams and policy folks.
maya_patel: Thanks. Keeping this thread as the triage channel — please post short updates only. :folded_hands:
